segments.text:
V. 1.
And he ſaid alſo to his diſciples—Not only to the Scribes and Phariſees, to whom he had hitherto been ſpeaking, but to all the younger as well as the elder Brethren: To the returning Prodigals who were now his diſciples. A certain rich man had a ſteward— CHRIST here teaches all that are now in Favour with GOD, particularly pardoned Penitents, to behave wifely, in what is committed to them.
